text:
ada: follow-up idea from today's design review  backpressure-aware shard ingest / prefetch gating. goal: prevent IO storms during large hotpatches and keep latency SLOs stable.
jun: +1. we keep hitting IO spikes when many shards try to warm simultaneously. what's the sketch?
mike: basic idea: add admission control for loader warmup. runtime exposes budget tokens (prefetch_tokens) that loaders must consume to start chunk IO. tokens are replenished by the backpressure controller based on IO queue depth, free mem, and first-token latency.
lena: does this require manifest changes? prefer opt-in.
ada: manifest opt-in: add "ingest_policy: backpressure_v1" with tunables. sample manifest snippet: ```yaml
manifest:
  version: 3
  ingest_policy:
    mode: backpressure_v1
    max_prefetch_tokens: 1024
    burst_window_ms: 500
    min_reserve_bytes: 64MB
    eviction_grace_ms: 2000
    slow_start: true
```
mike: loader API surface: reserve_prefetch(n_tokens) -> granted_tokens int; release_prefetch(n) for early return; on_low_tokens callback to slow down warmup. also support reserved_bytes_hint.
jun: how to integrate with KV-cache warmup? we should prioritize prefix-critical chunks and allow token-weighted reservation so requests with higher prefix_hit risk get priority.
lena: propose priority_hint in reserve_prefetch: {priority: high|normal|low, estimated_io_bytes}. controller uses priority + current SLOs to schedule grants.
ops-bot: CI:ingest-gate-check triggered for ada/1789994321, job #905 enqueued.
mike: telemetry plan: prefetch_grants, prefetch_denials, io_queue_depth, token_latency_p95, eviction_events. add alert if prefetch_denials > 1% for 5m.
ada: rollout: start with runtime shim that honors reserve_prefetch but defaults to unlimited (disabled). Then enable on a small dedicated pool with canary traffic 2% for 30m. Collect metrics -> tune defaults -> staged enable across clusters.
jun: fallback behavior: if controller fails, loader must revert to safe-mode: conservative sequential warmup with per-layer delays. must not block inference.
lena: (typo) lena: will add unit tests for reserve/release semantics and simulate fast/slow IO backends.
mike: question: private deployments / air-gapped: controller config must be local-only; manifest flags only influence behavior but operator can override. add 'operator_override: true' field.
ada: security note: ensure token accounting can't be abused by a tenant to starve co-tenants. controller should be per-tenant or weighted by priority.
infra-bot: infra:noticed disk scheduler knobs on staging SSDs, might help. will expose iops_limit option to controller.
lena: I'll draft the loader interface PR + tests. mike please own telemetry. jun -> private deploy docs.
mike: will add dashboards and a stress test script to the perf harness.
ada: thanks all. quick hack spike ok? I want a PoC that simulates 100 concurrent hotloads and shows p95 token latency improvement with gating.
jun: SGTM :thumbsup:
